claims.summary: Fresh deployed v0.15.55 evidence showed a 74/C Project Management package with prompt-artifact labels in student-facing output and partial enrichment caveats.
Course FAQ compilation now rejects compact numbered artifact runs and internal source placeholders before constructing student-facing answers.
Fallback Course FAQ repair strips terminal objective punctuation before adding its own sentence break, preventing double-period quality findings.
The release documents the remaining partial-enrichment and study-guide quality targets instead of weakening the grader or presenting the 74/C package as clean.
